rv.q: Birbiglia is creating something of an autobiographical life chronology with his work, and one can only hope that when he's 56, he comes up with another piece – emotional, funny, heartwarming, and everything in between.
The tone of wry self-mockery did not vary enough in tone or content to sustain a full evening.
Mike Birbiglia’s The Man and the Pool is an engaging and truly funny hit of a show.

cn.t: Critics embrace Birbiglia's autobiographical storytelling as emotionally resonant and funny, with most finding it heartwarming and compelling, though one review offers more measured praise.
